task_language: pick up the chocolate pudding and put it in the tray
behaviour_summary: pi0 moved to the robot's-left bowl (image right) by step 60 and then froze there with the gripper down over/around the bowl from step ~80 to the timeout (409), never lifting anything.

failures.mode_definition: pi0 approaches, grasps and/or relocates a non-instructed object (often to the instructed destination) instead of the instructed target object.
hl_remedy: HALT when the empty gripper descends toward a non-target object over 2 frames (VERIFY target grounding)
VERIFY gripper empty; if a non-target is held, ESCALATE (no put-back primitive)
REPROMPT 'pick up the chocolate pudding and place it in the tray'
WATCH 3 s for EE approach toward the target
failures.prevention: Coordinator VLM-checks which object the gripper is heading for in the first 2-3 frames and HALTs on a non-target approach before any grasp.
failures.observation: Step 20 arm at home; step 40 gripper descending directly above the image-right bowl; 60 onward the gripper sits on that bowl (bowl occluded) and the pose is essentially identical from 80 to 409. Pudding at front right and tray never touched.

notes: Secondary behaviour not recorded as a separate failure: after reaching the wrong bowl pi0 freezes for ~330 steps (no lift, no regrasp). Cannot tell from frames whether the bowl was grasped (fingers hidden) - if grasped, this is also a lift that never starts. Freeze is likely a consequence of the out-of-distribution target choice.
